derivation: Let l>0 be squarefree, l=11 mod12, beta=17 mod24 positive with nonempty proper support B0 inside supp(l), q0 outside, K*1_B0=0. Kummer coordinates are (x+3l,x-l), rational torsion images (l,1),(3,-l).
At2 beta=1 mod8 gives identity; at infinity beta>0 gives identity. At3 beta,l are units=2 mod3, so beta/l is a square by Hensel and the class equals (l,1).

For p=q_i in B0, the K equation sums the symbols of the complement, so l/beta is a unit square and the class is (l,1). For i outside B0 it sums beta-support symbols, so beta is a unit square and the class is identity. All support primes are odd and different from3.

At every remaining odd good prime beta is a unit. For good reduction and p odd the Kummer image is unramified; reduction and invertibility of2 on the formal group identify E(Q_p)/2E(Q_p) with E(F_p)/2, of order4 because all two-torsion is rational. Unramified H1 has order4 and equals the four unit-squareclass pairs. Thus (beta,1) belongs.

Globally beta is neither1 norl because its support is nonempty proper. The two other torsion classes have second coordinate -l, a negative nonsquare. Hence the extra class is independent; with the inherited at-most-eight calculation this supplies exact Selmer dimension3 for both constructed l.
